intro: What I am up to right now — like a quest log for my own life.

items.title: Shipping this blog
items.text: Built yukki-rui from scratch: bilingual posts, a browser admin, a no-login comment section, archive and Pagefind search, plus a build-time share image for every post. It runs on both Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages.
